summary: IFF filed an 8-K to report entering a $1 billion senior unsecured delayed draw term loan facility with Wells Fargo as administrative agent. The facility has a single borrowing available through September 25, 2026, matures December 31, 2027, and bears interest at Term SOFR plus 0.875%-1.500% based on debt ratings. Proceeds will refinance $800M 1.800% Senior Notes due September 2026. Mandatory prepayment of 100% of net proceeds from the expected ~$3.8B Food Ingredients business sale (closing Q2 2027) is required. The loan includes a 3.75x net debt/EBITDA covenant. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation.
